preconditions.description: The number of people n is between 1 and 50, and the boat's weight limit k is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(w == 50 or w == 100 for w in weights)
preconditions.description: Each person's weight is either 50 or 100 kilograms.
The weights list contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: min_rides == -1 or (min_rides >= 1 and all(sum(weights) <= k * min_rides, sum(weights) > 0))
postconditions.description: If transporting everyone is impossible, min_rides is -1; otherwise, it is the minimum number of rides required, ensuring the total weight can be transported within the boat's capacity.

postconditions.expression: ways == 0 if min_rides == -1 else (ways >= 0 and ways % 1000000007 == int(stdout.splitlines()[1]))
postconditions.description: If transporting everyone is impossible, ways is 0; otherwise, it is the number of distinct ways to transport everyone in min_rides rides, modulo 10^9 + 7.
The output consists of two lines: the first line is the minimum number of rides (or -1), and the second line is the number of ways modulo 10^9 + 7 (or 0).
